patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports developing swelling around her eyes and ankles over several days. She mentions a recent diagnosis of Hodgkin's lymphoma but has not started treatment yet. No history of kidney disease or similar symptoms in the past.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Edema, particularly around the eyes and ankles
Secondary_Symptoms: No changes in urine color or frequency

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Recently diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma. No other significant medical history.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. Currently a graduate student.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with recent onset of edema and significant proteinuria.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor. I’m 25, recently diagnosed with Hodgkin’s lymphoma, and over the past several days I’ve noticed swelling around my eyes and also around my ankles, along with some fatigue. I haven’t started any treatment yet, and I haven’t noticed any changes in my urine.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations) recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any scratched or raw skin areas, and I haven’t seen any small open spots or excoriations recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you suddenly wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any episodes of stopping breathing or suddenly waking up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, obvious swelling or deformity, inability to use the area, or pain that’s getting worse instead of better? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any injury or severe pain, swelling, deformity, or trouble using an area, and I’m not experiencing pain that’s getting worse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist compared to the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, from a bump, fall, coughing, or injury), or any new discoloration there?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising or new discoloration on my chest wall from any injury, coughing, or bump. I’ve mostly just had the swelling around my eyes and ankles and some fatigue.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine than normal?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been urinating more than usual—my urine color and frequency seem the same, and I’m not producing larger amounts.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t smoke or use tobacco, and I haven’t been drinking alcohol or using any cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs either recently or in the past.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine, and I haven’t been leaking or missing the bathroom.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any nosebleeds and I haven’t noticed any blood coming from my nose.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk, chest, back, or belly. The main issue has been the swelling around my eyes and my ankles, plus fatigue.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or thighs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs—no prominent varicose veins around my calves or thighs.”
